subject: How can I see the server variable str/values?

messages.author: b555f01b0716fd66
messages.subject: How can I see the server variable str/values?
parts:
Is there a way I can examine the value/structure of the variables in the console when I'm running the app?

I guess I could print them to the HTML but I was wondering if there was a way to see what the structure was for the input$variable for example.

In this case I'm trying to subselect my data based on a comparison like data[which(data$column == variable$input),] and I'm getting various errors like 'Error in unique.default(x) : unique() applies only to vectors' or if I try an coerce it into a factor 'Error in Ops.factor((data$column), as.factor(input$variable)) : level sets of factors are different'

If I could do a str of the input variable that would help me think about how to solve the problem.

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: How can I see the server variable str/values?
parts:
Try calling browser() from inside one of your reactives, it should work as it usually does.

Setting `options(shiny.trace=TRUE)` before starting your app can also help sometimes, it prints the JSON packets that are going back and forth between the browser and R.
